ended.reason: Closed at the owner's direction after both owned dossiers were released. This session was given two bundles about instruments -- 0041, a required shape nothing checks, and 0050, instruments that are correct and cannot fire -- and answered six of their nineteen members. Neither bundle reached a terminal standing, so both went back to the queue at Revision 317 rather than waiting on a session that had stopped advancing them; final-summary.md carries the disposal record and what each leaves open. What it built: the prose-total check (0041 D6), the derivation fixture set over all 63 presence-combinations, the two projection assertions (0041 D7), and the removal of a fourth copy of the standing derivation that disagreed with the original on 128 of 384 enumerated cases (0050 D4). What it got wrong and corrected in the record: the 0041 F7 disposal, reversed at Revision 312 on the owner's test that a bundle must be able to reach a terminal standing; and the UNCLEARABLE classification of 0049 F6, whose verdict was right and whose stated reason was wrong. Revision 289 has a manifest entry and no commit of its own -- its content landed inside 15069fe, whose trailer names another session -- which is 0050 F7's defect recorded in this session's own bundle.
